title: What does Gemini season feel like?
old_caption: Gemini season, named for the twin stars Castor and Pollux, is all curiosity and conversation. The easiest way to show someone you're interested is to ask the follow-up question, then really listen.

title: What does Cancer season feel like?
old_caption: Cancer season starts on the longest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere, and astrologers read it as home and care. Care is mostly small: ask how their day really went, and wait for the answer.

title: What does Leo season feel like?
old_caption: Leo season is warmth, play and being seen. The best way to glow is to make someone else feel seen: a specific compliment beats a big speech every time.

title: What does Virgo season feel like?
old_caption: Virgo season is details, helping and good routines, and our Pisces student learned that noticing is a kind of hug. Nobody needs to be perfect. Noticing the little things is enough.

title: What does Libra season feel like?
old_caption: Libra season opens at the September equinox, when day and night are close to equal. Fair in love isn't 50/50 every single day. It's taking turns, and trusting the other person will take theirs.

title: What does Scorpio season feel like?
old_caption: Scorpio season is depth, loyalty and starting over. If you want closeness fast, this one's for you: trust is earned slowly, and keeping something private isn't the same as keeping secrets.

title: What's your 3rd house?
old_caption: Your 3rd house, in astrology: siblings, neighbours, everyday talk and short trips. Love doesn't only live in big moments. A text to your sibling or a wave next door counts too.

title: What's your 4th house?
old_caption: In astrology, the 4th house sits at the very bottom of your chart: home, family and roots. Family can be the one you're born into and the one you build. This month, hold your boundaries kindly.

title: What's your 11th house?
old_caption: Astrologers read the 11th house as friends, community, and hopes and wishes. Friends are a love story too, so tell them. If you have a wish for the new year, say it out loud to a friend, then ask for theirs.

title: Why does the Moon follow my car?
old_caption:
Drove home from my ex's and the Moon followed me the whole way.
It's so far away its direction barely changes, so it seems to keep pace. Big feelings work the same: let them ride along, and they set.
